title: Concept: Raw-markup binding (ruby: .html_safe) — review required
description: In ruby, .html_safe disables the framework's automatic escaping for one binding. Raw-markup bindings exist for trusted rich text, but any untrusted bytes in the value become script. The remedy is text binding via default escaped output.
applicability: ruby templates and components using the raw binding; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Cross-site scripting, usually stored; MEDIUM severity, HIGH on authenticated pages.
